# has stream

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:hasStream`](gmeow-hasStream.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/hasStream>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/observations`](../../slices/observations.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

Links an entity to a stream of observations or samples about it. Non-functional: an entity may have multiple co-existing streams from different platforms or sensors ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)), and no stream is privileged.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Entity`](../classes/gmeow-Entity.md) -> [`gmeow:Stream`](../classes/gmeow-Stream.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:hasStream`](gmeow-hasStream.md) from [`gmeow:Entity`](../classes/gmeow-Entity.md) to [`gmeow:Stream`](../classes/gmeow-Stream.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:Entity`](../classes/gmeow-Entity.md), [`gmeow:Stream`](../classes/gmeow-Stream.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use from an entity to reach the streams of observations about it — the entity-rooted inverse of [`gmeow:streamOf`](gmeow-streamOf.md), when traversing from the tracked thing to its sample runs.

### Avoid when

- Avoid asserting it directly when you can state [`gmeow:streamOf`](gmeow-streamOf.md) instead (prefer the stream-rooted, functional direction and read this as its inverse), and avoid treating one stream as canonical — multiple coexist ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).

### How to use

- Assert [`gmeow:streamOf`](gmeow-streamOf.md) on the stream and read [`gmeow:hasStream`](gmeow-hasStream.md) by inversion; reach for it explicitly in entity-rooted projections that enumerate all sample runs about a subject.

### Examples

- ex:rover [`gmeow:hasStream`](gmeow-hasStream.md) ex:roverTrack.
